groups.saying_opens: يهل أهل المدينة من ذي الحليفة

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: both are stored, each group labelled with its saying (rule 4a)
«قال عبد الله» is Ibn Umar speaking again: the second group keeps the shared head up to him
«بلغني» is an unnamed gap between Ibn Umar and the Prophet (rule 8); the Prophet is the end
